title: ICICI Chennai Super Kings credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded Chennai Super Kings card from ICICI rewarding sports enthusiasts with cashback on merchandise, tickets, and lifestyle benefits for CSK fans.

items.child: 25% Discount Upto Rs 100 on Movie Tickets.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.description: 25% Discount Upto Rs 100 on Movie Tickets.
benefitRows.offer: Avail of a discount of 25%, upto ₹100 on a minimum purchase of two movie tickets per transaction on www.BookMyShow.com.|You can avail of this offer twice in a month.|Spend ₹25,000 in the preceding calendar quarter to unlock the quota for the current quarter. |Avail of a discount of 25%, upto ₹100 on a minimum purchase of two movie tickets per transaction on www.BookMyShow.com.|You can avail of this offer twice in a month.|Spend ₹25,000 in the preceding calendar quarter to unlock the quota for the current quarter.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.

benefitRows.name: Chennai Super Kings
benefitRows.offer: Monthly top spenders get Memorabilia autographed by Key Players of the Team.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, be one of the monthly top spenders on your ICICI Chennai Super Kings credit card. Eligible customers will receive memorabilia autographed by key players from the Chennai Super Kings team. For more details, contact ICICI Bank customer care at 1860 120 7777.
